text.title: Vice-President to Inaugurate Fifth Edition of Kashi Tamil Sangamam
text.one_liner: The fifth edition of Kashi Tamil Sangamam will be held from November 28 to December 12, 2026, in Varanasi, focusing on the Thirukkural.
text.summary: The fifth edition of Kashi Tamil Sangamam (KTS 5.0) will be inaugurated by Vice-President Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan in Varanasi, running from November 28 to December 12, 2026. Organized by the Ministry of Education with IIT Madras, BHU, and CICT, the event brings together 1,400 delegates from Tamil Nadu to celebrate civilisational ties. The theme for KTS 5.0 is “Thirukkural Payilvom – Thirukkural Abhyas Karen”. Participants will visit Varanasi, Prayagraj, and Ayodhya.

Venue: Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh
Number of Delegates: Around 1,400 participants from Tamil Nadu

text.title: STPI Inaugurates its 75th Centre in Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh
text.one_liner: Software Technology Parks of India launched its 75th centre in Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh, to strengthen the regional IT and startup ecosystem.
text.summary: Software Technology Parks of India (STPI) inaugurated its 75th centre in Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh. Developed with an investment of approximately ₹18.25 crore on a 2-acre land parcel, the centre aims to support IT/ITeS enterprises, startups, and technology-led entrepreneurship in the Rohilkhand region. Out of STPI's 75 centres, 67 are situated in Tier-II and Tier-III cities to decentralise technology infrastructure.

Investment: Approximately ₹18.25 crore

text.title: MWCD and MSDE to Jointly Launch NAVYA 2.0 in Haridwar
text.one_liner: The second phase of NAVYA will be launched in Haridwar to empower adolescent girls and young women across 100 districts.
text.summary: The Ministry of Women and Child Development and the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship are jointly launching NAVYA 2.0 in Haridwar, Uttarakhand. NAVYA 2.0 expands its reach to 100 districts across 24 States/UTs, broadening the eligible age group from 16–18 years to 16–25 years. The initiative offers vocational training in non-traditional job roles using the Skill India Digital Hub platform.

Launch Venue: Uttarakhand Sanskrit Academy Auditorium, Haridwar
Coverage: 100 districts across 24 States/UTs
Target Age Group: 16 to 25 years

text.title: National Conference on AYUSH Standardization Held at AIIA Goa
text.one_liner: AIIA Goa hosted a national conference on AYUSH Standardization to discuss the Standard National Action Plan 2027–32.
text.summary: The All India Institute of Ayurveda (AIIA), Goa, in collaboration with the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS), hosted a national-level conference on 'AYUSH Standardization – Standard National Action Plan (SNAP) 2027–32'. Stakeholders representing Ayurveda, Yoga and Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, Sowa-Rigpa, and Homoeopathy discussed standardisation strategies to ensure quality, safety, and widespread recognition for traditional healthcare systems.

text.title: Two-day Power Ministers’ Conference begins in New Delhi
text.one_liner: The two-day Power Ministers’ Conference commenced in New Delhi on November 27, 2026, chaired by Union Minister Shri Manohar Lal.
text.summary: The two-day Power Ministers’ Conference began in New Delhi, bringing together Power Ministers, senior officials, and electricity regulators from 28 states and 8 union territories. Chaired by Union Minister Shri Manohar Lal, the conference focuses on strengthening energy security, improving power infrastructure, and accelerating sectoral reforms. Discussions include smart meters, financial viability of DISCOMs, and nuclear sites. India's installed capacity reached about 563 GW, with over 55% from non-fossil sources.
key_points: Conference dates: November 27-28, 2026, held in New Delhi.
Chaired by Shri Manohar Lal, Union Minister of Power and Housing & Urban Affairs.
India's installed capacity is about 563 GW, with over 55% from non-fossil sources.
Power sector presents an investment opportunity of Rs 200 lakh crores over the next two decades.

text.title: India’s Growth Story Remains Strong Amid Global Uncertainties: Piyush Goyal
text.one_liner: Union Minister Shri Piyush Goyal stated at the India Debt Capital Market Summit 2026 that India's growth remains strong and resilient.
text.summary: Union Minister of Commerce and Industry Shri Piyush Goyal addressed the India Debt Capital Market Summit 2026, highlighting India's economic performance, sustained reforms, and expanding trade opportunities. He noted that India delivered 7.8% growth in the first quarter of the current financial year, with exports reaching USD 570 billion in the first seven months. Goyal emphasized the vision of Viksit Bharat 2047 and the goal of becoming a USD 30 trillion economy.

Exports reached USD 570 billion in the first seven months of the year.
Credit growth stood at about 19 per cent.
October recorded a record performance for exports at USD 90 billion in a single month.

text.title: CCI Approves Combination Involving Samara AIFs and Associated Road Carriers
text.one_liner: The CCI approved a proposed combination involving Samara AIFs, Calyx Container Terminals, and Associated Road Carriers.
text.summary: The Competition Commission of India (CCI) approved the proposed combination involving Samara Alternate Investment Fund – Scheme I LVF, Samara Alternate Investment Fund III India, Calyx Container Terminals Private Limited, and Associated Road Carriers Limited. The transaction involves the acquisition of a stake by Samara AIFs in Calyx, Calyx acquiring a stake in Associated Road Carriers (ARC), and the subsequent merger of Calyx with and into ARC.
key_points: Samara AIFs are Category II alternative investment funds registered with SEBI.
Calyx Container Terminals is engaged in providing container freight station facilities in India since 2006.
Associated Road Carriers Limited is engaged in logistics and surface transportation services since 1972.

text.title: Government Stock Auction Results Announced by RBI
text.one_liner: The Reserve Bank of India released the cut-off and auction results for Government Stock and Sovereign Green Bonds.
text.summary: The Reserve Bank of India published the auction results for Government Stock and Government Sovereign Green Bonds (SGrB). The auction included 6.20% GS 2029, 6.57% GS 2033, 7.63% GS 2056, and 7.50% GOI SGrB 2056 with notified amounts of ₹9,000 crore, ₹12,000 crore, ₹9,000 crore, and ₹3,000 crore respectively. Full notified amounts were accepted for 6.57% GS 2033, 7.63% GS 2056, and 7.50% GOI SGrB 2056, with nil devolvement on Primary Dealers.
key_points: Notified amount for 6.57% GS 2033 was ₹12,000 crore and was fully accepted.
Notified amount for 7.63% GS 2056 was ₹9,000 crore and was fully accepted.
Notified amount for 7.50% GOI SGrB 2056 was ₹3,000 crore and was fully accepted.
Devolvement on Primary Dealers was NIL across all categories.

mcqs.question: What was the notified amount for 6.57% GS 2033 in the RBI auction results?
mcqs.explanation: The notified amount for 6.57% GS 2033 was ₹12,000 crore.

mcqs.question: What was the devolvement on Primary Dealers for the auctioned Government Stocks?
mcqs.explanation: Devolvement on Primary Dealers was reported as NIL for all listed securities.

mcq.question: What was the notified amount for 6.57% GS 2033 in the RBI auction results?
mcq.explanation: The notified amount for 6.57% GS 2033 was ₹12,000 crore.

text.title: RBI Conducts 3-day Variable Rate Repo Auction on November 27, 2026
text.one_liner: The Reserve Bank of India conducted a 3-day Variable Rate Repo auction on November 27, 2026, allotting 75,006 crore rupees.
text.summary: The Reserve Bank of India announced the results of the 3-day Variable Rate Repo auction held on November 27, 2026. Against a notified amount of 75,000 crore rupees, total bids worth 1,35,656 crore rupees were received. An amount of 75,006 crore rupees was successfully allotted. The cut-off rate was recorded at 5.60 percent with a weighted average rate of 5.66 percent, and the partial allotment percentage of bids received at the cut-off rate was 0.42 percent.
key_points: Auction Date: November 27, 2026
Notified Amount: 75,000 crore rupees
Amount Allotted: 75,006 crore rupees
Cut off Rate: 5.60 percent
